content: Next.js static export (docs lastUpdated 2026-08-25): output:'export' emits one HTML per route into out/; trailingSlash:true emits /slug/index.html instead of /slug.html; 404.html always emitted. Dynamic routes REQUIRE generateStaticParams and dynamicParams:true is unsupported — set dynamicParams=false so unknown slugs 404. generateStaticParams runs before pages at build and can read local files (fs) or fetch. Unsupported: rewrites, redirects, headers, middleware/proxy, ISR, server actions, default image loader. Route handlers with force-static can emit static JSON files.
